entities.name: Matej Černic
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Matej Černič is an Italian volleyball player who won the silver medal with the Italian men's national team at the 2004 Summer Olympics, held in Athens. He is of Slovene ethnicity and belongs to the Slovene minority in Italy.
